events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The iconic Oasis frontman and solo artist, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam's Legacy
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite lyric or moment from the man himself?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released 55 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal album 'Imagine', featuring the iconic title track, was released on October 8, 1971, in the UK and September 9, 1971, in the US.

angles.name: Imagine Impact
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates today. What does it mean to you?

events.title: Apple released the first iPod 25 years ago
events.blurb: The original Apple iPod, revolutionising portable music, was unveiled on October 23, 2001, and released on November 10, 2001.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first time you put '1,000 songs in your pocket'? 25 years since the original iPod changed everything. What was on your first playlist?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated globally as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Favourite
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the villains, and of course, those iconic theme tunes. Who's your favourite Bond and why?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of legendary musician, songwriter, and peace activist John Lennon, born October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British actor, comedian, and screenwriter John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968, marking a pivotal moment in their career.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered 'The White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece. Which track is your absolute favourite?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie's Immortal Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury on the anniversary of his passing. His voice and stage presence remain legendary.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on December 3, 1965, showcasing a significant evolution in their sound.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Revolution
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. An album that pushed boundaries and influenced countless artists. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Today marks the tragic anniversary of the death of John Lennon, who was fatally shot on December 8, 1980, in New York City.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Message
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on the anniversary of his passing. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally.
